ddl_differences.name: app_equipment_items
ddl_differences.source_sql:
CREATE TABLE app_equipment_items (
		id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		is_custom INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_custom IN (0, 1)),
		name_zh TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		name_en TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		categories_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
		image_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		youtube_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		details_zh TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		details_en TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		kinesiology_zh TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		kinesiology_en TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		pt_tip_zh TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		pt_tip_en TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		ot_tip_zh TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		ot_tip_en TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		care_tip_zh TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		care_tip_en TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
		is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)),
		created_by TEXT,
		created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
		updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT, tcm_zh TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', tcm_en TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', tcm_enabled INTEGER CHECK (tcm_enabled IN (0, 1)), gif_left_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', gif_right_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', video_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', video_url_zh TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', video_url_en TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', video_localized INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (video_localized IN (0,1)),
		FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
	)
